posts.title: Tied Ambition Scoring for 5 player Arcs
posts.description: This post is about the scoring of tied tied ambitions in the board game Arcs: Conflict & Collapse in the Reach and its upcoming expansion Arcs: Lost Vaults & Fated Leaders . In Arcs, players win by collecting the most power which they get by scoring various ambitions . These ambitions are about having the highest count of a specific resource type or other game marker.
